Jules (CS): Hi team — starting HarborIQ onboarding thread. Top-level asks: sandbox peering, SSO + KMS, E2E chat smoke test inside 14 days, and a short enablement for support. Who takes owners?
Ravi (CSM): I can own stakeholder RACI, success criteria, and renewal watch. Suggest weekly 20-min sync Fridays 10am PT.
Marta (HarborIQ): Hi all, Marta from HarborIQ. Key constraint: our legal team will require 180-day audit log retention and exportability. Also prefer a recorded enablement for our support engineers.
Nina (Solutions): I'll take the tech lead. Need SSO metadata, CIDR ranges for peering, sample 90s conversation, and expected peak QPS. Also confirm whether you'll use streaming responses.
Ola (Security): I'll own the compliance questionnaire. 180d retention likely triggers archive flows; flagging potential legal review. Any PII expected in prompts?
Jules (CS): Owners: Ravi -> comms & renewal watch; Nina -> integration & perf; Ola -> security sign-off; Jules -> runbook + board upkeep; Marta -> provide artifacts and SRE contact.
Marta (HarborIQ): SSO contact: idp-admin@harboriq.ai. We'll share CIDR and sample convo by EOD tomorrow. No PII expected.
Nina (Solutions): Proposed timeline:
Day 0: Kickoff + collect SSO/KMS/CIDR/test accounts
Day 2: Sandbox provision + peering + smoke auth
Day 6: E2E integration test + perf baseline
Day 10: Observability + dashboard seed + runbook draft
Day 14: Enablement + customer sign-off
Ravi (CSM): Draft success criteria: sandbox auth from HarborIQ CIDR; E2E test passes with p95 within SLA; dashboard shows cost per convo under target; enablement session recorded and playbook delivered. I'll also add CRM renewal checkpoints 90/60/30/14.
Ola (Security): Risks: if legal requires export workflow it may add 7-10 days. If compliance slips beyond 10 days mark renewal-watch. Also firewall maintenance windows may add 48-72h.
Marta (HarborIQ): We'll prioritize getting artifacts quickly. SRE lead is @luc (luc@harboriq.ai).
scheduler-bot: Meeting scheduled: "HarborIQ Onboarding — Tech Deep Dive" tomorrow 11:00am PT. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood-internal/meet/harboriq-deepdive
Jules (CS): Next steps: 1) Marta uploads SSO/CIDR/sample convo (EOD), 2) Nina prepares test plan + perf targets, 3) Ola pre-reads questionnaire. Reconvene after deep-dive to lock Week 1 tasks. Drop blockers here. :rocket:
